annotations.title: Ask to add a bond series

description: Ask the editors to add a bond series listed on GPW Catalyst that get_bond did not find. Call it only after the user agrees. If the series is already in our data, the tool says so and records nothing. Only a confirmation is returned. Prośba o dodanie serii z Catalyst, której nie mamy.

code.description: Catalyst code (e.g. "ABC0528") or ISIN (e.g. "PLABC0000123") of the series.

note.description: Optional short note, e.g. where the user saw the series (max 200 characters).

name: request_bond
